reason.finding: The original 4 optimizer x 3 seed x 15 candidate design requires at least 540 official sessions and approximately 39.5 million proposer input tokens.
reason.decision: Replace the unexecuted mass run with a staged pilot while preserving the original preregistration unchanged.

terminology.tailrl_difference: The variant retains the same tabular RL policy and changes only a preregistered lower-tail reward/advantage; official TailRL is a distinct algorithm and is not reproduced.

official_loop_invariant.rule: Every optimizer uses the same official proposer and patch loop; only pre-session optimizer action/mutation-strategy selection may differ.

stage_0_artifact_eligibility.reason: The official scenario is fake and the complete patch is {"instruction":"improved"}; neither LM Studio nor the SQL task stream was evaluated.
stage_0_artifact_eligibility.anti_leakage_rule: A fake-scenario score may not be relabelled as Ministral or SQL validation evidence.

stage_1_official_baseline_validation.prerequisite: A target-task AutoSaddler candidate must already exist and be frozen before validation. The Gate A fake candidate does not satisfy this prerequisite.
steps: Freeze the target-task AutoSaddler patch and SHA-256.
Perform no further optimization of that candidate.
Evaluate the seed harness and frozen AutoSaddler harness on the identical validation stream.
Do not return validation feedback to AutoSaddler.
Measure whether development score 1.0 transfers to validation.

stage_2_optimizer_feasibility_screening.interpretation: feasibility screening only; no claim of RL superiority

stage_3_confirmation.versioning: new run version, never pooled into the screening table
stage_3_confirmation.methods: original AutoSaddler plus at most one alternative selected using development only

rl_definition.action_timing: mutation/patch strategy selected before the AutoSaddler call
rl_definition.online_update: policy updates after every candidate and the next action depends on the updated policy
rl_definition.tail_aware_difference: same policy implementation; only the preregistered lower-tail reward/advantage differs
